name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2026 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2026 record supports, from 1 January to 11 November 2026: the technique tables of the CISA and partner joint advisories of the year (AA26-097A, AA26-113A, AA26-194A, AA26-204A, AA26-222A, AA26-231A, AA26-237A, AA26-281A and AA26-293A), Microsoft's Storm-0940 and Storm-3168 reports, GTIG's PeopleSoft report, ESET's DynoWiper analysis, and the behaviors the year's vendor, victim and government records describe (Cisco SD-WAN, PAN-OS, Citrix, Ivanti, BeyondTrust, Trivy, LiteLLM, axios and the other supply-chain compromises). Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2026.md. Scores: 100 an opened source prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
